sequence: Specified after the 16-day mask pilot and previous calibration results; before extended QA, time-window and timing-marker results. These are exploratory follow-up analyses, not a blind benchmark.

quality.retain: All FireMask and QA values on native grid cells; decode land/water and representative day/night bits. Keep every daily class count. Never use the daily composite as a clear-sky overpass denominator.

time.window: 8–12 of every calendar month in archive years; current 8–12 November 2026
time.local_time: UTC minutes plus longitude times four, modulo 1440; approximate mean solar time
time.model: One regional ratio per calendar quarter for each predefined time restriction. Select times before cell-day deduplication. No tuning on held-out or recent results.
time.support_gate: Do not interpret a current time-restricted estimate unless each sensor retains at least 50% of its unrestricted detected cell-days and both have at least 20 cell-days. This is an engineering diagnostic gate, not statistical validation.
time.interpretation: Presence-only time filtering cannot establish complete co-observation or causally partition sensitivity, orbit drift and burning behaviour.

timing_marker.definition: First date at which 10% of the full calendar year's observed Aqua cell-days have accumulated. Sensitivity at 5% and 20%. Remove February 29 and use a 365-day calendar. Not first ignition, not operational onset, and unavailable prospectively until the year is complete.
timing_marker.comparison: Aqua and independently computed adjusted NPP marker in each case year; compare with the same-instrument historical median and empirical range. No significance or causal inference.

investigation_candidates.eligibility: At least 5 median reference cell-days; Aqua and adjusted NPP both above that cell's historical p90
investigation_candidates.ranking: Descending smaller of the two positive excesses above the Aqua median. Greedily retain three centres at least 0.5 degrees apart. Show all qualifying-cell count and selection rule.
investigation_candidates.meaning: Retrospective imagery-review candidates, not fire perimeters, exposure, operational priorities or validated local calibration.

external_validation: Not conducted; user explicitly requested proceeding without it. Prepare a task-based evaluation protocol, never fabricate participant results.
